guidance.before:
Arbitrary result schemas are desktop-owned; the headless
  brain declines resultSchema rather than accepting it without validation.
guidance.after:
The shared Rust host validates arbitrary result schemas in standalone and
  embedded modes; older peers may refuse them.

guidance.before:
host-authored contract is available on desktop and headless fleet dispatches
  even though headless declines arbitrary resultSchema.
guidance.after:
host-authored contract is available on standalone and embedded Rust fleet
  dispatches alongside validated arbitrary resultSchema.

Fleet workflows require a compatible owning Rust host, in standalone or
embedded mode. A paired worker may execute remotely while that host owns the task.
Older hosts may return unavailable; report that plainly, never claim a workflow ran.
